Contract RepairService::approve(sid: Integer,rid: Integer,reject: Boolean,suggestion: String): ApprovalHistory {
	definition:
		repair: Repair = Repair.allInstances()->any(r: Repair|r.Id = rid),
		staff: Staff = Staff.allInstances()->any(s: Staff|s.Id = sid)
	precondition:
		Repair.allInstances()->exists(r: Repair|r.Id = rid) and
		Staff.allInstances()->exists(s: Staff|s.Id = sid)
	postcondition:
		let approvalHistory: ApprovalHistory in
		approvalHistory.oclIsNew() and
		ApprovalHistory.allInstances()->includes(approvalHistory) and
		approvalHistory.StaffId = sid and
		approvalHistory.Reject = reject and
		approvalHistory.Suggestion = suggestion and
		repair.History->includes(approvalHistory) and
		(if reject = true 
		then if staff.Role = 1 
		then repair.Process = 1 
		else if staff.Role = 2 
		then repair.Process = 2 
		else if staff.Role = 3 
		then repair.Process = 3 
		else repair.Process = repair.Process@pre 
		endif  
		endif  
		endif  
		else repair.Process = 5 
		endif ) and
		result = approvalHistory
}

Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::withdrawCash(quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	precondition:
		self.CardIDValidated = true and
		self.PasswordValidated = true and
		self.InputCard.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.InputCard.Balance>=quantity
	postcondition:
		self.InputCard.Balance = self.InputCard.Balance@pre-quantity and
		self.IsWithdraw = true and
		self.WithdrawedNumber = quantity and
		result = true
}

Contract ProcessSaleService::makeCashPayment(amount: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentStore: Store = Store.allInstances()->any(store: Store|store.Sales->exists(sale: Sale|sale = self.CurrentSale))
	precondition:
		self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
		self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and
		amount>=self.CurrentSale.Amount
	postcondition:
		let payment: CashPayment in
		payment.oclIsNew() and
		CashPayment.allInstances()->includes(payment) and
		Payment.allInstances()->includes(payment) and
		payment.AmountTendered = amount and
		payment.Balance = amount-self.CurrentSale.Amount@pre and
		payment.BelongedSale = self.CurrentSale and
		self.CurrentSale.AssoicatedPayment = payment and
		self.CurrentSale.Belongedstore = currentStore and
		self.CurrentSale.Time = Now and
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = true and
		result = true
}

Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::borrowBook(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		targetUser: User = User.allInstances()->any(candidate: User|candidate.UserID = uid),
		targetCopy: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(candidate: BookCopy|candidate.Barcode = barcode),
		targetStudent: Student = Student.allInstances()->any(candidate: Student|candidate.UserID = uid),
		targetFaculty: Faculty = Faculty.allInstances()->any(candidate: Faculty|candidate.UserID = uid),
		matchingReservation: Reserve = Reserve.allInstances()->any(candidate: Reserve|candidate.ReservedUser = targetUser and
		candidate.ReservedCopy = targetCopy and
		candidate.IsReserveClosed = false)
	precondition:
		User.allInstances()->exists(candidate: User|candidate.UserID = uid) and
		BookCopy.allInstances()->exists(candidate: BookCopy|candidate.Barcode = barcode) and
		targetUser.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and
		targetUser.SuspensionDays = 0 and
		(if targetUser.oclIsTypeOf(Student) 
		then if targetStudent.Programme = Programme::BACHELOR 
		then targetUser.LoanedNumber<20 
		else if targetStudent.Programme = Programme::MASTER 
		then targetUser.LoanedNumber<40 
		else targetUser.LoanedNumber<60 
		endif  
		endif  
		else if targetUser.oclIsTypeOf(Faculty) 
		then targetUser.LoanedNumber<60 
		else false 
		endif  
		endif ) and
		(targetCopy.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE or
		(targetCopy.Status = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF and
		targetCopy.IsReserved = true and
		Reserve.allInstances()->exists(candidate: Reserve|candidate.ReservedUser = targetUser and
		candidate.ReservedCopy = targetCopy and
		candidate.IsReserveClosed = false)))
	postcondition:
		let newLoan: Loan in
		newLoan.oclIsNew() and
		Loan.allInstances()->includes(newLoan) and
		newLoan.LoanedUser = targetUser and
		newLoan.LoanedCopy = targetCopy and
		targetUser.LoanedBook->includes(newLoan) and
		targetCopy.LoanedRecord->includes(newLoan) and
		newLoan.LoanDate = Today and
		newLoan.IsReturned = false and
		(if targetUser.oclIsTypeOf(Student) 
		then newLoan.DueDate = Today.After(30) 
		else newLoan.DueDate = Today.After(60) 
		endif ) and
		targetUser.LoanedNumber = targetUser.LoanedNumber@pre+1 and
		targetCopy.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and
		newLoan.OverDue3Days = false and
		newLoan.OverDue10Days = false and
		newLoan.OverDue17Days = false and
		newLoan.OverDue31Days = false and
		(if targetCopy.Status@pre = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF 
		then targetCopy.IsReserved = false and
		matchingReservation.IsReserveClosed = true 
		else true 
		endif ) and
		result = true
}

Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		User.allInstances()->forAll(user: User|if user.SuspensionDays@pre>0 
		then (user.SuspensionDays = user.SuspensionDays@pre-1 and
		if user.BorrowStatus@pre = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND and
		user.OverDueFee@pre = 0.0 and
		user.SuspensionDays@pre = 1 
		then user.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL 
		else user.BorrowStatus = user.BorrowStatus@pre 
		endif ) 
		else user.SuspensionDays = user.SuspensionDays@pre 
		endif )
}
